$Comment: A Master's lesson on the trainer's board, posted in the slot that opens at Master (Exalted) and the second that opens at Grandmaster (Mastery_Trainer_Tier_3): earn experience in any skill while carrying it, twice the Hard lesson's total. The step names no skill, so every skill counts. It writes its own Rewards.Claim, the base's list with more standing and one mastery point (the Currency reward on the pack's mastery_point wallet), because a child's list replaces the base's whole. The mastery gate comes from Mmo_Lesson_Base.
